Everything works. Here's what was implemented:

**Files created/modified:**

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Models/TicketData.cs` | ML.NET data classes (`TicketData` for training, `TicketPrediction` for output) |
| `Models/TicketRequest.cs` | API DTOs (`TicketRequest`, `PredictionResponse`, `EvaluationResponse`) |
| `Services/TicketClassifierService.cs` | ML pipeline — featurizes Subject + Description text and Priority, trains SDCA Maximum Entropy classifier, runs 3-fold cross-validation for metrics |
| `Controllers/TicketController.cs` | `POST /api/ticket/classify` (prediction) and `GET /api/ticket/metrics` (evaluation) |
| `Program.cs` | Registers the classifier as a singleton (trains at startup) |

**Key design choices:**
- **SDCA Maximum Entropy** multiclass trainer — good for text classification
- **3-fold cross-validation** for metrics since the dataset is small
- Confidence scores map to each category label from the trained model
- Input validation rejects missing text and out-of-range priority
